description: Test/mock implementation of system call wrappers for the SystemMock class, used for mocking system functions like system, unlink, access, and others in tests.

methods.name: int system(const char * cmd)
methods.description: Wrapper for the system call, delegated to g_SystemMock->system if g_SystemMock is defined, otherwise returns 0.

methods.name: int unlink(const char * str)
methods.description: Wrapper for unlink system call, delegated to g_SystemMock->unlink if g_SystemMock is defined.

methods.name: int access(const char * pathname,int mode)
methods.description: Wrapper for access system call, delegated to g_SystemMock->access if g_SystemMock is defined.

methods.name: int vsnprintf(char * str,size_t size,const char * format,va_list ap)
methods.description: Wrapper for the vsnprintf function, delegated to g_SystemMock->vsnprintf if g_SystemMock is defined.

methods.name: int remove(const char * pathname)
methods.description: Wrapper for the remove system call, delegated to g_SystemMock->remove if g_SystemMock is defined.

methods.name: int v_secure_system(const char * cmd,...)
methods.description: Wrapper that formats a command string with variable arguments and delegates to g_SystemMock->v_secure_system if g_SystemMock is defined.

ctags.name: access
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" int access(const char * pathname, int mode)$/

ctags.name: vsnprintf
ctags.pattern: /^extern "C" int vsnprintf(char* str, size_t size, const char* format, va_list ap)$/
